canvas.responsive_rule: Keep essential labels inside the central safe area, use no more than six visual clusters per page, use large bilingual labels only where they aid recall, and preserve legibility on mobile, tablet and laptop screens.
canvas.visual_rule: Pure educational infographic; no slogans, decorative filler, invented quotations, unsupported numbers, fake seals, or unlabeled maps. Every dated value must carry its assessment or reporting date.

concepts.title: Andhra Pradesh in India's biogeographic scheme
concepts.concept_direction: A clean Andhra Pradesh relief silhouette split visually between the coastal plain in Zone 8/Province 8B East Coast and the Eastern Ghats in Zone 6/Province 6C Eastern Highlands, with a small current-zone key for 8 Coasts, 9 North-East and 10 Islands.
concepts.full_direction: Explain zone versus province through one nested hierarchy, contrast the coast and hill forests, and include a version-control panel showing that older schemes may attach different meanings to zone numbers. Maximum five clusters.

concepts.title: Why Andhra Pradesh's coastline length changed
concepts.concept_direction: The same Andhra Pradesh coastline measured once with a coarse line and once with a high-resolution line, labelled older approximately 974 km and revised April 2025 approximately 1,053.07 km.
concepts.full_direction: Use a coastline-paradox style visual to show how resolution and method alter measured length; identify both figures and dates without implying that the physical coast suddenly grew. Maximum four clusters.

concepts.title: Eastern Ghats: scale, breaks and vegetation
concepts.concept_direction: A discontinuous Eastern Ghats chain crossed by the Godavari and Krishna, with AP ranges Nallamala, Seshachalam, Palakonda, Velikonda and Papikonda, plus scale labels approximately 1,750 km, 75,000 km² and AP share nearly 40%.
concepts.full_direction: Contrast the lower, drier, broken Eastern Ghats with the wetter continuous Western Ghats; show moist-to-dry deciduous gradation and clearly label all scale/share figures as broad regional estimates rather than gazetted boundaries. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Rayalaseema drylands and Ananthapuramu degradation
concepts.concept_direction: A rain-shadow cross-section leading to Rayalaseema thorn scrub and dry grassland, with Ananthapuramu at the centre of a five-part degradation chain: irregular rain, aridity, tree/soil-carbon decline, groundwater extraction and wind erosion.
concepts.full_direction: Explain how the pressures reinforce desertification, then separate tree cover from forest cover in a compact comparison; treat open drylands as ecosystems rather than failed forests. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Restore the ecosystem that belongs there
concepts.concept_direction: A split restoration decision: protect native Rollapadu grassland and thorn scrub without dense tree planting; restore coastal mangroves and palmyra belts against cyclone and erosion exposure.
concepts.full_direction: Show habitat-to-action matching, Great Indian Bustard dependence on open habitat, and three wrong-treatment examples such as dense woodland on grassland or mangroves in inland drylands. Maximum five clusters.

concepts.title: Reading Andhra Pradesh's protected-area network
concepts.concept_direction: A dated legal-category dashboard showing 3 National Parks, 13 Wildlife Sanctuaries, no notified Community or Conservation Reserve at the reference date, and NSTR as an overlapping tiger-reserve layer; distinguish the two Rajiv Gandhi sites by category and location.
concepts.full_direction: Explain why overlapping designations cannot be added as separate protected areas and contrast Rajiv Gandhi National Park at Rameswaram/Penna with Rajiv Gandhi Wildlife Sanctuary in Nallamala/NSTR. Mark all network totals as date-sensitive. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Protected sites differ in role and legal status
concepts.concept_direction: Five compact site cards: Papikonda river-gorge connectivity, Nelapattu pelican-breeding sanctuary, Telineelapuram/Telukunchi bird areas, Koundinya tri-state elephant landscape and Kambalakonda urban-edge forest.
concepts.full_direction: Map legal category, ecological role and main pressure for each site; use Papikonda to show that Polavaram effects include riparian submergence, flow alteration and weakened north-south connectivity. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Rollapadu and the evidence standard for local extinction
concepts.concept_direction: An evidence ladder from historical Great Indian Bustard presence to recent non-observation, habitat-suitability modelling and the much higher threshold required for a formal local-extinction conclusion.
concepts.full_direction: Separate the 2026 WII habitat-suitability study from a field census, explain why model output is not a zero count, and state that sustained survey evidence is required before declaring local extinction. Maximum five clusters.

concepts.title: NSTR: overlapping protection and post-bifurcation identity
concepts.concept_direction: A layered NSTR landscape showing approximately 3,728 km² total, 2,444.14 km² core and 1,283.36 km² buffer over Rajiv Gandhi and Gundla Brahmeswaram sanctuaries, beside a 1983-2014-2015 bifurcation timeline.
concepts.full_direction: Explain India's largest tiger reserve by area, the overlap of legal and management layers, and how the former undivided reserve became present-day NSTR in AP and Amrabad in Telangana while remaining ecologically connected. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: How to read Andhra Pradesh tiger numbers
concepts.concept_direction: Three non-combinable evidence cards: AITE 2022 AP total 63, AP Forest annual-report NSTR 2024 figure 76, and separate camera-trap account 87; each card visibly carries scope, source and date.
concepts.full_direction: Teach source-scope-date control, note the 2022 local-extinction finding for Sri Venkateswara National Park, and explain why 76 and 87 cannot be averaged or merged. Do not present a future AITE result as available. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: One Nallamala landscape across two states
concepts.concept_direction: A male tiger moving through continuous Nallamala forest between NSTR and Amrabad across an administrative border, with a Chenchu community and Forest Rights Act rights shown as part of the same landscape.
concepts.full_direction: Contrast ecological continuity with state administration and show the dual conservation requirement: maintain animal movement corridors and respect Chenchu PVTG rights and participation. Maximum four clusters.

concepts.title: Seshachalam status and shared management
concepts.concept_direction: A status pathway showing India's 20 September 2010 national Biosphere Reserve designation, no UNESCO World Network inscription, and proposal not equal to approval; beside it, Forest Department plus TTD shared management and Bairluty rescue centre clearly separated.
concepts.full_direction: Explain national designation versus UNESCO inscription, proposal versus approval, TTD's local institutional role in Seshachalam, and why Bairluty is a location in the NSTR-Nallamala landscape rather than another name for Seshachalam. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Red sanders: endemism, regulated trade and enforcement
concepts.concept_direction: A red-sanders tree rooted in its restricted southern Eastern Ghats range, connected to a CITES Appendix II permit checkpoint and the joint Police-Forest anti-smuggling task force.
concepts.full_direction: Contrast endemic with native, explain that Appendix II means regulated international trade rather than a universal ban, and show illegal felling-to-smuggling enforcement in the Seshachalam-Velikonda belt. Maximum five clusters.

concepts.title: Kolleru: hydrology, functions and three different areas
concepts.concept_direction: A freshwater floodplain-lake flow diagram: Budameru and Tammileru into Kolleru, Upputeru outlet, wintering birds and flood storage; three separate area labels for Ramsar 90,100 ha, sanctuary 308 km² and seasonally variable water spread.
concepts.full_direction: Explain natural ecological functions versus Ramsar recognition, why the three area measures are not interchangeable, and proposal versus legally notified boundary. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Pulicat and Kolleru: different wetlands, shared pressures
concepts.concept_direction: A split wetland cross-section: brackish Pulicat lagoon behind Sriharikota with tidal salinity gradient, mudflats and seagrass; freshwater Kolleru floodplain; shared pressure icons for aquaculture conversion, nutrient runoff and reduced freshwater inflow.
concepts.full_direction: Show Pulicat's sanctuary and IBA recognition but absence from the official Ramsar list, explain different effects of reduced inflow, and add a precise Wetlands Rules 2017 panel explaining the aquaculture-pond definition issue without implying converted natural wetlands automatically lose protection. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Andhra Pradesh mangroves and the fishing cat
concepts.concept_direction: A Godavari-Coringa mangrove food-web scene centred on a radio-collared fishing cat, with ISFR cards 408.42 km² in 2021 and 421.43 km² in 2023 and clearly scoped rank labels.
concepts.full_direction: Explain WII plus AP Forest Department radio-collaring, fishing-cat wetland adaptations and trophic role, and distinguish AP's fourth rank among all states/UTs from second among mainland east-coast states. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Olive ridley nesting on the Andhra Pradesh coast
concepts.concept_direction: Biologically accurate olive ridley turtles nesting diffusely along Andhra Pradesh river-mouth beaches, with the 2000-01 baseline of about 4,000 nests and north/central 60-100 versus south 15-20 nests per kilometre.
concepts.full_direction: Explain survey period and publication date, dispersed nesting versus Odisha arribada mass nesting, the AP coast's migration-route role, and why this historical baseline must not be presented as a current population estimate. Maximum five clusters.

concepts.title: Great Green Wall of Andhra Pradesh
concepts.concept_direction: A coastal bioshield of mangroves and palmyra reducing cyclone, storm-surge and erosion exposure, clearly distinguished from Africa's arid-Sahel Great Green Wall; dated implementation counters appear as subordinate evidence.
concepts.full_direction: Show the AP programme's coastal-resilience mechanism and dated 2026 reporting: over 13 lakh palmyra seeds collected against five lakh initial target, over 1.65 lakh planted, 740 ha mangrove restoration in 2024-25 and 1,930 ha in 2025-26. Separate planting/restoration reports from survival-verified outcomes. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: New to science is not rediscovery
concepts.concept_direction: A scientific-description workflow for Hemiphyllodactylus venkatadri from Tirumala-Seshachalam in 2025, contrasted with a rediscovery pathway for an already named but long-unrecorded species.
concepts.full_direction: Explain comparison with known taxa, assignment of a scientific name and publication of the formal description; do not invent an IUCN category, range size or discovery date beyond the source. Maximum four clusters.

concepts.title: Eastern Ghats cycads: listing authority matters
concepts.concept_direction: A side-by-side botanical comparison: Cycas beddomei, southern Eastern Ghats endemic, CITES Appendix I and formal IUCN Endangered; Cycas seshachalamensis, described in 2016 from Seshachalam foothills at about 200-600 m, with author-proposed Critically Endangered status.
concepts.full_direction: Separate CITES trade appendices from IUCN extinction-risk assessment and formal IUCN listing from an authors' criterion-based proposal; include red sanders Appendix II only as a concise comparison. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Jerdon's Courser: point endemism and evidence control
concepts.concept_direction: An accurate Jerdon's Courser in narrow Andhra Pradesh scrub, with confirmed historical range and a separate September 2025 reported acoustic indication from Lankamalla Hills outside Sri Lankamalleswara Sanctuary.
concepts.full_direction: Explain Critically Endangered status, point endemism and the distinction among acoustic detection, reported confirmation, peer-reviewed publication and formal range revision. Treat the 2025 report as provisional pending peer-reviewed evidence and do not label the species CITES-listed. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: From Biodiversity Heritage Site proposal to notification
concepts.concept_direction: A legal-status pathway from APSBB proposal/forwarding through competent-government process to Gazette notification, with Veerapuram and Timmamma Marrimanu visibly paused at proposal status.
concepts.full_direction: Explain why recommendation does not confer legal status and provide an exam-safe count rule: include a site as notified only when the Gazette step is evidenced. Maximum four clusters.

concepts.title: Pavithravanams and the Borra landscape
concepts.concept_direction: A community-protected sacred grove as in-situ conservation but not a statutory protected area, linked to a Borra cross-section that separates limestone karst caves, shrine and adjoining grove; include approximately 730 documented AP groves.
concepts.full_direction: Explain customary protection, approximate inventory status, Borra's 2021 vegetation figures of 31 tree species/28 genera/20 families and Combretaceae prominence, and the Visakhapatnam-to-ASR district-name change after 2022. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Project H.A.N.U.M.A.N. response network
concepts.concept_direction: A dated 3 March 2026 wildlife-response network: 100 GPS vehicles split into 93 response vehicles and 7 ambulances, four treatment centres, AI-assisted warnings and Vajra teams.
concepts.full_direction: Map centres at Visakhapatnam, Rajamahendravaram, Tirupati and Bairluty; distinguish launch date from publication date and show why tiger-dispersal and elephant-corridor conflicts require different preventive actions despite one response network. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Biodiversity and wetland governance
concepts.concept_direction: Two coordinated governance trees: NBA to APSBB to local BMC/PBR, and Wetlands Rules to Andhra Pradesh State Wetland Authority with Minister chair and senior environment secretary vice-chair.
concepts.full_direction: Explain PBR documentation of biological resources and traditional knowledge, multi-agency tiger-landscape governance, State Wetland Authority functions, and why the membership in G.O.Rt.No.89 of 24 October 2019 was a three-year reconstitution rather than a timeless current list. Maximum six clusters.

concepts.title: Coastal-zone planning and approval stages
concepts.concept_direction: A process diagram from APCZMA appraisal and state CZMP preparation/forwarding to NCZMA review and approval, with the Madhurawada-Bheemunipatnam CRZ-III B to CRZ-II recommendation shown as a recommendation, not a completed reclassification.
concepts.full_direction: Present the June 2026 recommendation and the 8 May 2026 meeting-record status: hearings complete in 12 of 13 coastal districts, Visakhapatnam pending and CRZ-2019 plan approval still pending. Mark every stage and date precisely. Maximum five clusters.

concepts.title: Post-bifurcation state symbols
concepts.concept_direction: Four accurate AP symbol portraits under G.O. 59 dated 30 May 2018: blackbuck, rose-ringed parakeet, neem and jasmine.
concepts.full_direction: Compare the AP set with Telangana's spotted deer, Indian roller, Jammi tree and Tangedu flower to prevent post-bifurcation confusion; use accurate species morphology and no unofficial emblem styling. Maximum five clusters.

concepts.title: Applying biodiversity governance across a landscape
concepts.concept_direction: One connected Andhra Pradesh landscape linking NSTR tiger recovery and conflict, narrow-range Eastern Ghats species, red-sanders CITES trade control, Chenchu community rights and state implementation institutions.
concepts.full_direction: Use a decision web to show how habitat connectivity, extinction risk, international trade regulation, local rights and institutional implementation interact; avoid reducing the synthesis to a list or implying that one institution controls every function. Maximum six clusters.

cross_concept_tie_breaks.question_theme: AP coastline plus coastal bioshield or mangrove restoration
cross_concept_tie_breaks.rule: Map to c05 when the tested inference is resilience/restoration; use a02 only when measurement method is decisive and c03 only when mangrove-cover assessment is decisive.

cross_concept_tie_breaks.question_theme: Rollapadu grassland, Great Indian Bustard and restoration
cross_concept_tie_breaks.rule: Map to a05 for habitat treatment or afforestation error; map to b03 for evidence of presence, non-observation or local extinction.

cross_concept_tie_breaks.question_theme: NSTR tiger count, corridor movement and governance
cross_concept_tie_breaks.rule: Map to b05 for number/source/date control, b06 for movement and Chenchu/FRA rights, and d06 for a multi-principle governance synthesis.

cross_concept_tie_breaks.question_theme: Seshachalam endemism, Biosphere Reserve status and institutions
cross_concept_tie_breaks.rule: Map to b07 for designation or TTD governance, b08 for red-sanders trade/enforcement, c06 for the Venkatadri gecko's taxonomic status, and c07 for cycad status authority.

cross_concept_tie_breaks.question_theme: Kolleru or Pulicat status, hydrology and governance
cross_concept_tie_breaks.rule: Map to c01 for Kolleru hydrology/area/boundary, c02 for comparison, Pulicat or shared pressures, and d03 for institutional competence under the Wetlands Rules.

cross_concept_tie_breaks.question_theme: Mangroves, fishing cat, olive ridley and coastal resilience
cross_concept_tie_breaks.rule: Map to c03 for mangrove cover or fishing-cat ecology, c04 for turtle nesting evidence, and c05 for bioshield programme design or implementation figures.

cross_concept_tie_breaks.question_theme: Endemism, new species, rediscovery and status authority
cross_concept_tie_breaks.rule: Map to c06 for new-species versus rediscovery, c07 for formal versus proposed plant status, and c08 for point endemism or the Jerdon's Courser acoustic-evidence chain.
Map to c09 for Biodiversity Heritage Site legal notification, b07 for Biosphere Reserve/UNESCO status, and d04 for CRZ recommendation or CZMP approval stage.
